headline: Assembly Chamber Janitor Resigns After Legislators Force Him to Referee Paper-Airplane Dogfight
body:
The state legislative assembly witnessed an unprecedented disruption today as the primary floor janitor, 54-year-old Rameshwar Rao, officially submitted his resignation after being repeatedly tapped by senior members to serve as an independent arbiter for inter-party paper-airplane duels. Mr. Rao, who has maintained the legislative carpets for two decades, claimed the final straw occurred when two prominent opposition leaders demanded he use his standard-issue broom to signal the start of a 'maximum-velocity' aerial engagement across the Speaker’s well.

'I am hired to sweep discarded manifestos and policy drafts, not to certify the flight duration of modified A4 sheets of paper,' said a visibly exhausted Mr. Rao while collecting his cleaning supplies from the locker room. 'One member handed me a stopwatch and told me to measure the lift-to-drag ratio of his custom origami F-16, while the other insisted I declare a winner based on which plane managed to land closer to the Finance Minister’s water glass. I just wanted to finish my shift and catch the 6:15 bus.'

Witnesses report that the legislative proceedings stalled for nearly three hours as lawmakers engaged in a heated debate over the aerodynamic legitimacy of folding edges on government-branded stationery. According to an eyewitness clerk who requested anonymity, several members even attempted to draft an emergency motion to designate the janitor’s dustpan as the official ‘Landing Zone for Diplomatic Conflict Resolution.’

Following the incident, the Secretariat has scrambled to fill the vacancy, though prospective candidates are reportedly wary of the job description. A spokesperson for the housekeeping department confirmed that future recruits will be required to hold a basic certification in sports officiating and have an intermediate understanding of fluid dynamics to better manage the chamber’s evolving legislative culture.
caption: When the job description says 'maintaining order' but you end up as a judge for legislative aircraft design. #TelanganaAssembly #LegislativeDrama #PaperPlaneWars #AssemblyLife (satire)
igHook: Would you quit your job if your boss made you referee an office paper-airplane war?

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 9 wins because it provides a specific, vivid, and highly relatable absurd scenario that doesn't rely on tired office tropes. The detail regarding the janitor's resignation due to an 'F-16 paper airplane' dogfight creates genuine cognitive dissonance and warmth, avoiding the formulaic 'canteen scuffle' pattern found in several other submissions.
